notes: Approved catalogue-to-catalogue healthier-alternative mappings. Alternatives are chosen from each rule's candidate pool (the same product family, addable from the catalogue) by price availability, never by nutrition: a candidate is eligible only when it has at least 5 official price observations; the two eligible candidates with the lowest median observed price are approved; when no candidate in the pool carries a price the single previously approved unpriced alternative is kept as a fallback so the product family does not lose the feature. A nutritional recommendation does not imply a lower price.
